lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Luke and Layton walk past Crater Elementary.

lines.speaker: layton
lines.text: Ah, look at that, Luke! A field trip!

lines.speaker: layton
lines.text: According to that sign, they're going to the store to learn how to use a cash register.

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: Even the children are braver than me...

lines.speaker: layton
lines.text: Nonsense! They're simply learning, just as you are.

lines.speaker: stranger
lines.text: Excuse me, are you two volunteering for the field trip?

lines.speaker: stranger
lines.text: Wonderful! We need chaperones. Here, take this permission slip.

lines.speaker: layton
lines.text: I'm afraid we must decline. We have our own shopping to do.

lines.speaker: stranger
lines.text: Oh, how delightful! Teaching by example!

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: That's not what he— never mind. Let's just go, Professor.

lines.speaker: layton
lines.text: Well handled, Luke. See? You're already helping others.

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: I just want to get to the car...

sequence.text: A little further down the road...
